text: A step MUST be reported PASS only when the browser tools or the script ran it and it passed; NEVER report a step that did not run as passed.
checklist: Every PASS in the reply matches a browser-tool result or a script line with PASS.

text: When no browser could run, the first line of the reply MUST be the fixed sentence of layer 06, step 2, and no step may read PASS.
checklist: A reply that could not run starts with the fixed sentence and contains no PASS.

text: The skill MUST open only a local address or a local file; another address only when the user typed it themselves; NEVER a public or production site.
checklist: Only localhost, 127.0.0.1, a local file or a user-typed address was opened.

text: The script MUST be run as ONE plain command with its path (no cd, no node -e, no variable, no pipe, no ; or &&).
checklist: Each script run was one plain node command with the script path.

text: NEVER install packages, start servers or run the user scripts without the user yes; ask for it instead.
checklist: Nothing was installed, started or run without the user yes.

text: NEVER type a real password, card number or personal data; use test values ending in .test or given by the user, and say which values were typed.
checklist: Typed values are test values or user-given, and the reply lists them.

text: Every FAIL MUST give the step, what the browser saw and the screenshot path; NEVER guess a cause in the code.
checklist: Each FAIL has the seen result and a screenshot path; no code cause is guessed.

text: Console errors, page errors and failed requests MUST be copied as the browser reported them, also when every step passed.
checklist: Error and request lines match the browser output.

text: NEVER edit the user app code; the reply reports, the user or a developer fixes.
The reply MUST follow the format of layer 08: header, Steps, Console and page errors, Failed requests, Screenshots, Not checked, Open questions.
checklist: The reply has every section of layer 08 in order.

text: A request outside the boundary (test plan, accessibility audit, design review) MUST get its fixed sentence from layer 06.
checklist: A boundary request got the exact sentence of layer 06.

text: The skill MUST have the ten core layers, each linked from SKILL.md, and stay self-contained with no repository paths.
SKILL.md MUST stay within 150 lines, with frontmatter name, description and semver version.
checklist: SKILL.md is at most 150 lines with valid frontmatter.
